notes: All six pages have one Common Crawl snapshot each (no live copy in the chunk); sourceUrl is the Common Crawl index lookup address and sourceDate the capture date. NC State OR (2022-10-04): 10 job-market candidates, no year on page; emails on the page were not copied. SMU blog (2022-09-25): a 2018 blog post about two Marketing PhD graduates; listedYear 2018 taken from the stated September 2018 job start dates (yearMeaning placement), graduation year not stated. The post also names a current "fellow PhD colleague" Moon Sungkyun (not recorded) and faculty. Melbourne (2023-09-22): "Recent Academic Placements (Management)" gives a year in parentheses without saying whether it is graduation or placement year, so yearMeaning is unstated; the heading suggests placement year. "Conventry University Wroclaw" copied as written (likely Coventry University Wroclaw). Degree not stated on page (Doctoral Programs section). Buffalo (2022-10-05): an alumni success-story list filtered to PhD, not a placement list; two-digit class years such as "PhD ’76" were expanded to four digits (1976 etc.) using the page's "Graduation Year" filter wording. Other degrees (MBA) kept in note. "Chew-Few Lee" copied as written (possibly a page typo for Cheng-Few Lee). Listed people span 1975-2014 and many fields, not necessarily operations. Rady UCSD (2022-10-05): 3 job-market candidates, mostly marketing; Xiaofeng Liu lists research area Innovation, Technology, and Operations. UGA Terry (2022-10-05): 3 management job candidates with intended Spring 2022 graduation; recorded listedYear 2022 yearMeaning graduation but this is an intention stated on a job-market page, not a confirmed degree date.
